engine.version_requirement: turso_serverless crate =0.1.0 and the credentialed Turso Database service API qualified by release evidence

topology.logical_database_isolation: one credentialed Turso Database cloud namespace per Native logical database; no local replica

operational_identity.write_authority: Only a successful acknowledgement from the remote Turso Database service can make a write authoritative; transport failure after dispatch may be outcome-unknown until independently resolved.
operational_identity.consistency: Network-required remote service visibility. No local fallback or stale local reads are permitted; concurrent-write and transaction semantics remain unproven for Native.
operational_identity.file_semantics: There is no local database file or offline authority in this profile. Provider backup and canonical interchange are the only candidate recovery artifacts.
provider_dependencies: turso:// database URL and scoped authentication token
explicitly qualified provider plan, region, limits, durability, backup, and restore behavior
promotion_rules: Vendor beta or production claims are not Native support evidence.
Promotion requires credentialed Native logical, transaction, concurrency, failure-boundary, migration, backup, restore, and disaster-recovery suites for this exact driver and service identity.
No deterministic local or turso::sync result transfers to this profile.
Any engine, driver, protocol, topology, write-authority, consistency, provider-plan, or provider-region assumption change creates a new immutable profile revision.

native.domain-mcp.v1.notes: Local and sync evidence do not prove direct remote execution.

native.raw-sql.notes: No reviewed caller-row authorization boundary exists for direct remote SQL.
